economy.summary: A war-driven oil shock pushed inflation back up, so the Fed raised rates in September instead of cutting, and long-term interest rates jumped. At the same time hiring nearly stopped. That mix (higher prices, slower jobs) is hard on stocks priced for fast growth and on companies whose customers feel squeezed, and kinder to energy producers, banks and steady defensive companies.
economy.fed: The Fed raised rates on Sept. 16, its first hike in three years, because oil pushed inflation up. Markets see a chance of another hike by December.
economy.fedNext: The next Fed meetings are Oct 27–28 and Dec 8–9. After the hot September inflation report, futures markets put the chance of another quarter-point hike on Oct 28 at about 35% (CME FedWatch, Oct 14), and most Fed officials who have spoken, under Chair Kevin Warsh, expect one more hike by year-end. Futures price roughly a two-in-three chance that rates end 2026 at 4.00–4.25%.
economy.oil: The US–Iran war has largely shut the Strait of Hormuz since late February. The strait carries about a fifth of the world's oil, so prices have hovered near $100 and gasoline topped $4.20 a gallon in September.

NKE: Fiscal Q1 beat on profit (adjusted EPS $0.48 vs. $0.44 expected), but revenue fell 4% to $11.2B, Greater China sales fell 22%, and Nike now expects fiscal 2027 revenue to fall by a high-single-digit percentage with EPS of $1.15 to $1.35 (Wall Street had about $1.67). It also launched a $2.5B cost-savings plan.
JPM: Q3 profit rose 6% to $15.3B and revenue rose 8% to $50.2B, but adjusted EPS of $5.75 missed estimates near $5.85. Equity trading jumped 49%, buybacks were cut 84% from Q2, and the full-year net interest income outlook was raised to about $106B.
TSM: Q3 revenue of $46.7B (up 41%) beat the top of its own guidance; EPS rose 69% with a 58.7% operating margin. TSMC guided Q4 revenue to $52.3B to $54.3B (about 58% growth) and now expects 2026 revenue to grow about 44%.
ASML: Record Q3 sales of 11.7B euros with a 57.5% gross margin. ASML guided Q4 sales to 14.2B to 15.2B euros and full-year 2026 to 44B to 45B euros, saying customers raised equipment plans because of AI.
NFLX: Q3 revenue grew 12% and operating income rose 37% to $4.5B (34.6% margin); EPS was $0.87 vs. $0.59 a year ago and churn improved. Q4 revenue is guided to $13.4B (about 12% growth) and 2026 to $51.1B.
TSLA: Q3 deliveries of 486,532 beat the 461,974 consensus but were 2.1% below last year's record; energy storage deployments of 13.7 GWh missed. Full Q3 results were due Oct 21 after the close and aren't reflected in this research yet.
UNH: Q3 beat (adjusted EPS $4.69 vs. $4.15 expected) and 2026 guidance was raised to at least $20.50 per share.
